valuation.pe_withheld_reason: Withheld: no market capitalisation on file in the earnings currency. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.basis: current market cap vs the newest period both statements cover
valuation.pb_withheld_reason: Withheld: the income statement and the balance sheet share no period (income newest FY2026, balance newest FY2024), so earnings, book value and the market cap cannot be put on one period. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
